vb_textbox.text: Try to keep your number of mushrooms over 4. The maximum is 9 and the minimum is zero. There are two pairs of gnomes and you pick from one of the two pairs each time. Once you find a good gnome in each pair, keep selecting it. However, the correct gnome appeared to change over time, so keep selecting one that is giving you 6-9 mushrooms, but if you get under 4 for a couple of goes, then change to select the other gnome. The gnomes on the left also seemed to give more mushrooms (more 9s) than when they were on the right!
